body:
Below is a summary of my experiences with the new RC known as 25H-NBOMe. It is a currently unscheduled alternative to the powerful and popular primary NBOMe series (25i, 25c, 25b).
A little about me: Previous psychedelics used: 25I-Nbome, 25B-Nbome, LSD, shrooms, LSA.
Most recent use of psychedelics prior to experience report: 3 months.
No prescription drugs or any medications in system up to 3 weeks prior to testing. Never prescribed a Benzo or SSRI.
A third or a half of a tab of 25B is more than enough to give me an intense trip for 8 hours. A full tab is almost too 'face-meltingly' intense for me without a very comfortable and fairly well controlled environment.
Anyways, I received a large quantity of 25H tabs to test amongst myself and friends. So after a large number of reports that the tabs were nearly or wholly ineffective, I decided to try them myself. I had 3 sheets, so I cut one tab from each sheet (to test against the possibility of just one sheet being defective) and found a suitable and comfortable time and environment to trip.
10:30PM (T+0) First tab is taken, and placed between lower lip and gum. An extremely minty, bitter, metallic, chalky taste is immediately noticed. It tasted much more 'intense' than my numerous previous experiences with other Nbomes, all of which just tasted metallic/bitter
T+5: Tongue, gums, and lower lip are all very numb.
T+30: No visual effects at this point, eyes are dilated.
T+45: Another tab is taken, and the previous tab is discarded.
T+55: My ears are ringing, which is always exacerbated by any kind of drug use (even cannabis or alcohol).
T+75: No apparent visual effects felt.
T+80: Got bored and shared a blunt with some friends that were accompanying me.
T+90: Smoking helped, and I began to feel a little better about the evening.
T+95: Another tab is taken, and the previous tab is discarded.
T+120: No apparent visual effects, I ate some food, as I hadn't had any dinner that night, and drank some bottled water. I was able to remain social and talkative, didn't have the constipation/nausea of other NBOMes, and would have been perfectly fine to drive and/or operate heavy machinery. I also noticed that there was still some vasoconstriction, but not quite as bad as other 25B.
T+180: Still no effects felt, and at this point my two friends split a large shroom chocolate between them, and went upstairs. After a very long week I was quite tired, so I decided to lay down and text for a while before falling asleep shortly thereafter. When I closed my eyes, there were mild visual effects, but nothing to write home about and easily surpassed by a good bong rip or some DXM.
T+210 (around 2AM): By this point I fell asleep easily, unlike other Nbomes which would have caused 8ish hours of energy and distracting visuals on as little as a third of a tab.
END
Another friend of mine took 9 tabs (9x 2000mcg) and had a light and mild trip. I can't imagine that ingesting so much of a new Phenylethamine is healthy at all (and certainly not cost-effective by any means), and one would probably be considerably better off using a more documented NBOMe or other drugs. The high provided by this substance is nothing special and can easily be replicated or surpassed by a number of drugs that I can get at the pharmacy or my friendly neighborhood dealer.
Perhaps it would be more effective if administered in a different manner, but that is an avenue I don't feel any need to explore (I'm not a fan of insufflation or injection), especially when other NBOMes are readily and cheaply available.
